explanation: High vibration + hot bearing + rumbling/grinding strongly supports bearing distress.
Crackling noise with poor suction condition and pressure fluctuation is characteristic of cavitation.
Coupling-dominant vibration with heating is consistent with shaft misalignment.
Low flow/head and reduced efficiency can indicate impeller fouling or blockage.
Leakage together with elevated seal-area temperature strongly supports seal failure.
Poor suction pressure with low flow/head supports suction restriction.
Loss of prime/no flow with rapid heating is a critical dry-running pattern.
High current with motor heating supports overload.
Coupling vibration plus mechanical noise supports coupling damage/looseness.
Reduced hydraulic performance plus vibration can result from impeller damage/erosion.
High discharge pressure, low flow and rapid heating support excessive discharge restriction.
Air bubbles with unstable flow/pressure support suction-side air ingress.
Localized base vibration with high overall vibration supports foundation/base looseness.
Motor heating, unstable speed and abnormal current support electrical supply imbalance.
